question: How late may an examination candidate enter the exam room?
expected_answer: The regulations generally allow entry up to 30 minutes after the official start.

question: What must I do at the end of an examination when the invigilator tells me to stop?
Can I take rough work papers out of the examination room?
expected_answer: Rough work and other official exam material must remain in the room.

question: Which documents do I bring to each examination?
expected_answer: Bring your identity card and admission card.

contexts.phrase: identity card and the admission card

question: Does poor internet connectivity qualify under the EC technical issues list?
expected_answer: The EC guide lists poor internet connectivity among technical problems that will not be approved.

question: Which board reviews an Extenuating Circumstances claim?

contexts.phrase: claims are reviewed by the ec board

question: Do the EC guidelines accept OPD medical certificates?
expected_answer: The document says OPD medical certificates are not accepted.

question: Which recovery strategy options are listed on the repeat registration form?
expected_answer: Select Coursework or Exam plus Coursework.

question: What details about the module and lecturer go on the repeat assignment submission form?
expected_answer: Enter the module code, module name and lecturer name.

question: Can I book an overnight guest room in the student residence?
expected_answer: Housing reservations are not covered by the corpus.
